question: State the matters on which the auditor of a company must report under the Companies (Auditor's Report) Order, 2020 in respect of property, plant and equipment and intangible assets.

points.label: Proper records
points.description: Whether the company keeps proper records showing full particulars, including quantitative details and location, of property, plant and equipment, and proper records of intangible assets.

points.label: Physical verification
points.description: Whether management has physically verified property, plant and equipment at reasonable intervals, whether any material discrepancies were found, and whether they were properly dealt with in the books.

points.label: Title deeds of immovable property
points.description: Whether title deeds of all immovable property shown in the financial statements (other than property taken on a duly executed lease) are held in the company's name; if not, the auditor gives the prescribed details, such as the description, carrying value, name in which held and reason.
keywords: held in the name of the company

points.label: Revaluation
points.description: Whether the company revalued its property, plant and equipment (including right-of-use assets) or intangible assets during the year, whether this was based on a registered valuer's valuation, and the amount of change where it is 10% or more of the net carrying value of a class.

points.label: Benami property proceedings
points.description: Whether any proceedings have been started or are pending against the company for holding benami property under the Benami Transactions (Prohibition) Act, 1988, and whether the company has properly disclosed the details.

points.label: Reasons for unfavourable answers
points.description: Where the answer to any of these matters is unfavourable or qualified, the auditor also states the reasons in the report.
